notes.title: INVERT Is Now Free To Play
notes.content:
Hey,

I've decided to make INVERT: The Climb completely free to play on Steam. I posted an announcement when I decided to make this decision but I will recap the details here to.

The reason for this change is that unfortunately I have lost access to the majority of source code of the project. If I were to add or update this game, I would have too remake 30% of the game's code which isn't possible for me due to time constraints and just the fact that this made me lose motivation. Because I can no longer update or add any content, I don't feel right to charge for this game.

So as of right now, INVERT: The Climb is available at no cost, so feel free to try your hand at it. Thank you for all the support for the game.

Sorry and Thanks,
Slushy.

notes.title: Intention of making 'INVERT' Free To Play
notes.content:
Hey,

After a long thought for a couple weeks. I've decided to make 'INVERT: The Climb' free to play. I'm making it F2P as I have lost the source code to the project so I can longer update it. Because I can't update it, it feels wrong to charge for it. I would of liked to release a final update but that isn't possible.

I will post another announcement once the game becomes Free to Play.

Thanks, Slushy.

notes.title: INVERT IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Damn... my game is finally out. Feels like a fever dream right now but yea... it's happening.

For the next week, the game will be 15% off as a celebration for the game's release.

I'm going to wrap this up as I don't know what to talk about here... I think I'm suppose to ask you to buy the game so... buy the game... I guess, or I mean I hope. You get the idea though.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575230/INVERT_The_Climb/

notes.title: Small Bugfixing Patch
notes.content:
The demo is now live! I've been dreaming of the time when I can say "I have a game on steam" and it's getting ever so closer. Remember, the game releases on the 16th of February which is in just 18 days!

Anyway, this is just a small little update to fix some bugs I got. You can report any bugs through the in-game bug reporter tool or if needed, Twitter which is just @SlushyRH. Although it's better to report any bugs in-game.
